title: A lane's ready mark is refused when its PR head is a replacement branch, not the step's branch
why: Consultant relay 15:59 CST Nov 16, from the coordinator at 15:48 CST on PR 3570: a lane's --ready call is refused when the pull request's head is a replacement branch rather than its step's lane branch. PR 3592 allows a lane's ready mark only when the head is the step's own lane branch (either head form).
